phishstats.page_text: Ledger.com/Start® | Getting started — Ledger top of pageBuilt on Welcome to Ledger: Start Your Journey to Secure Crypto Management Congratulations on taking the first step toward true ownership and security for your digital assets. This page is your launchpad to setting up your Ledger device and navigating the Web3 universe with unparalleled confidence. Ledger isn’t just a wallet; it’s the gateway to a new, secure financial future where you are in complete control. Why Start with Ledger? In a digital world where software alone is vulnerable, Ledger provides the ironclad solution. Our devices are built around a Secure Element chip—the same technology used in passports and credit cards—designed from the ground up to keep your private keys, and therefore your crypto, completely isolated from online threats. Starting here means choosing a foundation of security that millions trust. Your Getting Started Roadmap Follow this simple, three-step process to go from box to blockchain mastery. Step 1: Unbox & Set Up Your Ledger Device Unbox Your Kit: Ensure you have your Ledger device (Nano S Plus, Nano X, or Stax), USB cable, recovery sheet, and keychain strap. Connect & Power On: Plug your Ledger device into your computer or mobile device using the provided USB cable. Follow the on-screen instructions on the device to choose your PIN code. This PIN is your first line of physical defense—memorize it. Download Ledger Live: This is your command center. Go to Ledger.com and download Ledger Live, our official companion app, onto your desktop or smartphone. Always download software directly from our official website. Step 2: Initialize Your Security: The 24-Word Recovery Phrase This is the most critical step in your crypto journey. Your device will generate a unique 24-word recovery phrase. This phrase IS your master private key. It controls all your accounts. Write it by hand on the provided recovery sheet. Do not type it, screenshot it, or store it digitally. Verify the phrase on your device’s screen as prompted. Confirm you’ve recorded it correctly. Guard it like treasure: Store the sheet in a safe, durable, and secret place. Anyone with this phrase can access your assets. We recommend a fireproof safe. Ledger’s Golden Rule: Ledger will never, under any circumstances, ask for your 24-word recovery phrase. It never leaves your device. Any request for it is a scam. Step 3: Explore with Ledger Live With your device set up, Ledger Live becomes your hub. Add Accounts: Use the “Add Account” feature to create accounts for different cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, Ethereum, etc.). Each account is protected by your hardware device. Receive Crypto: Select an account, click “Receive,” and verify the address on your Ledger’s screen. This double-check ensures you’re not sending to a malware-generated address. Manage & Grow: Use Ledger Live’s built-in features to buy crypto, stake assets to earn rewards, swap tokens securely, and connect to Web3 applications—all with the constant protection of your hardware wallet. Dive Deeper: What Can You Do with Ledger? Your new device unlocks a world of possibilities beyond simple storage. Buy, Sell, & Swap: Partnering with trusted third-party providers, Ledger Live lets you buy crypto with a card or bank transfer and swap tokens directly within the app, with the security of your device confirming every transaction. Earn Passive Rewards: Securely stake a growing list of assets (like ETH, DOT, or ATOM) directly from Ledger Live to earn rewards, all while your keys remain offline. Explore Web3 & NFTs: Connect your Ledger device to Web3 applications like MetaMask or OpenSea via “Ledger Connect.” Interact with DeFi protocols, mint NFTs, and play blockchain games—your assets never leave your secure hardware, even when you’re exploring new frontiers. Manage All Your Assets in One Place: Ledger Live supports over 5,500 coins and tokens. View your entire portfolio’s value, track performance, and manage everything from a single, secure interface. FAQs: Your Starting Questions, Answered 1. I just received my Ledger. How do I know it’s genuine and hasn’t been tampered with? Ledger devices have a genuineness check integrated into the setup process within Ledger Live. The app will automatically verify the cryptographic integrity of your device. Additionally, ensure the box seals are intact and the recovery sheet is blank. If Ledger Live cannot verify your device during setup, do not proceed and contact our support immediately. 2. What happens if I lose my Ledger device or forget my PIN? This is exactly why your 24-word recovery phrase is essential. If you lose your device, simply purchase a new Ledger (or any compatible BIP39 wallet), select the “Restore from Recovery Phrase” option, and enter your 24 words. Your entire wallet, including all accounts and transaction history, will be recovered. Your PIN is only for accessing that specific physical device. 3. Can I use my Ledger with my smartphone? Absolutely. You can use Ledger Live Mobile (available for iOS and Android) to manage your portfolio on the go. For a Bluetooth-enabled device like the Ledger Nano X, you can connect wirelessly. For the Ledger Nano S Plus, you can use a compatible USB-C to USB/lightning cable. Your private keys always remain secure on the device. 4. Do I need to update my Ledger device? Yes, periodically. Firmware updates are released to add new features, support for more assets, and critical security enhancements. Ledger Live will notify you when an update is available. Always ensure your device firmware and Ledger Live app are up to date for optimal security. 5. Is it safe to connect my Ledger to third-party apps (like MetaMask or OpenSea)? Yes, this is one of Ledger’s core strengths. When you connect via “Ledger Connect” or similar secure protocols, you are signing transactions with your device. The app can request a transaction, but it cannot access your private keys or initiate transfers without your explicit approval on the Ledger’s screen. Always verify the transaction details on your device’s display. 6. Why do I need to confirm transactions on the device screen? This is your security guarantee. It creates a “trusted display” that is completely isolated from your potentially vulnerable computer or phone. By physically verifying and approving the recipient address and amount on your Ledger’s screen, you are preventing any malware on your computer from altering the transaction. If the details don’t match, reject it. You’re Not Alone on This Journey Starting with crypto can be exciting, and we’re here to ensure it’s also secure. Explore our extensive Ledger Academy for beginner-to-advanced guides on blockchain, security, and investing. If you need help, our 24/7 Customer Support team is ready to assist. Ready to take control? Set up your device, download Ledger Live, and step into a world where security and sovereignty are standard.
